preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)
Victim address must hold some BabyApe tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the burn() function with any victim address and amount to destroy their tokens. This reduces total supply and could potentially increase the value of remaining tokens (including owner's tokens), giving the owner economic advantage. The attack doesn't directly transfer tokens to attacker but creates economic benefit through supply reduction.
